notes: Correctly declines to guess a specific register map and data-format detail (the right instinct -- inventing register numbers is exactly what the general_reasoning sibling answer does, and gets wrong). But the decline is scoped to 'the Mitsubishi FX5U manual pages I have,' when the actual missing information -- which registers hold the weight value and the required data format -- lives in the Baykon BX11-EN weighing indicator's documentation, not the FX5U's. Asking the technician to upload 'the manual' without naming which of the two devices' manuals actually contains the answer is not the right next step for a two-vendor integration question. This is a milder version of the same problem as the CM Lodestar case: the abstention names the wrong (or at least incompletely specified) document as the fix. No fabricated facts, so no critical-claim flag, but correctness/actionability suffer for not pointing at the BX11-EN documentation specifically.
